prompt: Create one complete, realistic, isolated curtain as a regular household product. Visible geometry and style: 竖向整面百叶帘，覆盖整扇窗户; 简约现代百叶帘. Use materials ['塑料'] and colors ['白色']. Preserve ['水平百叶条纹形态', '白色调']. Regularize temporary disorder with ['整理叶片保持均匀平整']. Simplify modeling complexity with ['简化单叶片细节，保留整体条纹感']: use clean broad surfaces, shallow orderly folds, separated non-intersecting parts, and avoid tangled fabric or dense tiny wrinkles. Complete occluded, back, side and underside regions using {'type': 'repeated_modules', 'completionRule': '按现有百叶间距重复排列叶片'} and ['补充被遮挡区域的百叶结构']. Texture rule: 水平均匀排列的细百叶条纹; 延续水平百叶的均匀重复纹理. Target plausible real-world dimensions are approximately 0.70 m wide, 0.05 m deep and 1.30 m high. Preserve the corresponding width-to-depth-to-height proportions. These are category-prior estimates rather than pixel measurements. Use conservative category structure, repeated modules, continuous closed geometry, and one 45-degree product view on a plain light background. Keep only the main object.
